title: Ten Thousand at the Border
description: The checkpoint numbers came in at five this morning: ten thousand, two hundred and forty Dravenni refugees in seven days — fourteen times the average weekly intake. The Iron Covenant is already in front of cameras. The aid organizations are already at the camps. Your cabinet is waiting.

title: Constitutional Draft — Final Committee
description: The final committee is meeting. The draft that emerges this week is the one that goes to referendum. Every remaining amendment must be filed by Friday.

title: Budget Allocation — Refugee Response
description: The refugee crisis requires emergency funding. Interior needs camp resources. Health needs epidemiological support. The treasury needs to know where the money is coming from.

title: Vael's Proposal — Follow-Up
description: Vael sent a written proposal following the dinner. Twelve pages, single-spaced. He calls it 'a framework for economic stability during constitutional transition.' Vyktor calls it a set of demands with a table of contents.

title: Military Readiness — Border Assessment
description: Brenner's weekly briefing includes an annex on eastern border force posture. The refugee flow is being monitored by Tyvaren border units. The general wants to discuss what 'monitored' means in operational terms.
